scope: Full finite rounding lemma: for every equal-mass measurable partition, arbitrary real matrix M, measurable balanced two-block set and a<b, cut proximity δ gives a vertex set with cardinality imbalance ≤16δn/(b−a) and matrix cut error ≤33δ. Includes arbitrary measure-preserving pullbacks of the canonical interval partition. No symmetry or boundedness of M is needed. All signed tests, exact cell-average identities, projection deficit, sign rounding, balance and L¹ tensor estimates are proved.
